verdict.rationale: Channel3 is an agentic-commerce catalog and API layer, so verifiable agent identity is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents nothing about registered agent profiles, signatures, or trust tiers that merchants could use to tell trusted agents from anonymous bots. API keys, keyless MPP payments, and a user identifier for click attribution are adjacent features, not merchant-facing agent identity verification.

support.subject: As a merchant, agents identify themselves verifiably — registered profiles, signatures, or trust tiers — so I can tell trusted agent traffic from anonymous bots
